executable_actions.on_failure: Retain unknown or uninspectable facts as explicit evidence gaps and mark applicable checks not_run or failed according to their results. Do not guess board wiring or address values, upgrade declarations to verified evidence, or claim implementation/runtime/deployment readiness; route unresolved binding decisions for approval.
executable_actions.rationale: Inspect the materialized board profile, field-evidence rows/candidates, material index, and sample-project index against the named memory, runtime, deployment, stream-order, and beat-pipeline constraints. Produce an evidence-strength review and gap matrix; this is an input audit, not a board or runtime execution.

executable_actions.on_failure: Record failed or not-run checks and source-bound ambiguities in the review and fact-and-gap matrix. Do not claim pass or promote unsupported facts; route any established model contradiction to the cross-layer SACG gate for a bounded resolution.
executable_actions.rationale: The available summary does not expose enough artifact content to establish decoder semantics, model shapes, or operator order. Review the full source artifacts with the registered checkers and bind each reported fact or gap to its source; do not infer model facts.

executable_actions.on_failure: Record the failing or not_run checker, the affected artifact and constraint, and the unresolved binding in the review and gap matrix; hand off to input_preparation.cross_layer_sacg_gate. Do not promote an unverified binding or modify numeric policy, templates, or design-space targets.
executable_actions.rationale: Evaluate only the supplied numeric policy, template library and metadata, and design space against their named SACG constraints. Record unavailable detail as unresolved or not_run; do not invent formats, template support, or parameter values.

executable_actions.on_failure: Record each failing or unresolved contract as a bounded capability, evidence, or approval gap in the produced artifacts; mark unsupported evidence not_run/unverified. Do not claim pass, execute real tools, assume availability, change approval boundaries, or promote downstream work on unresolved required checks. Do not create a new compile-only tool solely because an existing verification role includes functional_sim in its name.
executable_actions.rationale: The required artifact classes are present in the state, but their detailed contracts are not visible in the supplied summary. Checker-grounded inspection is needed to establish usable tool/evidence contracts and explicit autonomous-change limits without executing tools or claiming their results.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep SACG extraction blocked for each failed or unassessed constraint; record checker evidence and not_run status accurately, route the bounded correction to its responsible input owner, and rerun affected registered checkers. Do not guess missing facts, waive checkers, alter golden outputs or numeric policy, or claim hardware pass.
executable_actions.rationale: Consolidate only checker-supported specialist findings and verify cross-layer bindings before SACG extraction. The visible compact summary is insufficient to establish readiness; registered checkers can validate the detailed source inputs and review artifacts without claiming implementation or deployment results.
